title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Ceramics
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which of the following materials is the primary raw material for making glass?
questions.explain: Sand (specifically Silica sand) is the main ingredient in glass making.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which of these is a property of ceramic materials?
options: They are good conductors of electricity
questions.explain: Ceramics (like pottery, glass, tiles) are hard but brittle; they break easily upon impact and do not stretch (not malleable).
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Products made from clay are generally fired in a special oven called a:
questions.explain: Ceramics (bricks, pottery) are fired in a Kiln to harden them.
